얼굴_참조_이미지.tooltip: The only reference image in face-only mode. In balanced mode it is used as image2 and defines facial identity, facial structure, skin tone, age, hairstyle, and hairline.

생성_모드.name: Generation Mode
생성_모드.tooltip: Face-only creates face-focused images only, and outfit diversity does not meaningfully apply. Balanced creates both face images and body-framing images, and outfit diversity applies only to the upper-body, thighs-up, and full-body images.
생성_모드.description: Face-only creates face-focused images only, and outfit diversity does not meaningfully apply. Balanced creates both face images and body-framing images, and outfit diversity applies only to the upper-body, thighs-up, and full-body images.

배치수.name: Image Count
배치수.tooltip: 24 is the most compact set, 30 is the default recommended balance, and 40 is the expanded set with more framing and viewpoint variety. Use 40 when you plan to review and curate the results.
배치수.description: 24 is the most compact set, 30 is the default recommended balance, and 40 is the expanded set with more framing and viewpoint variety. Use 40 when you plan to review and curate the results.

조명_옵션.name: Lighting
조명_옵션.tooltip: 사용안함 omits explicit lighting instructions. 안정적분산 distributes safer lighting matched to the background, and 다양한분산 uses a broader lighting range.
조명_옵션.description: 사용안함 omits explicit lighting instructions. 안정적분산 distributes safer lighting matched to the background, and 다양한분산 uses a broader lighting range.

의상_다양성.name: Outfit Diversity
의상_다양성.tooltip: Has little to no effect in face-only mode. It only controls how many outfit types are used by the balanced upper-body, thighs-up, and full-body images.
의상_다양성.description: Has little to no effect in face-only mode. It only controls how many outfit types are used by the balanced upper-body, thighs-up, and full-body images.

배경_옵션.name: Background
배경_옵션.tooltip: Controls the range of simple backgrounds. Backgrounds are kept visually separated from the person and are constrained not to overlap the subject.
배경_옵션.description: Controls the range of simple backgrounds. Backgrounds are kept visually separated from the person and are constrained not to overlap the subject.

표정_변화.name: Expression Diversity
표정_변화.tooltip: Controls expression range. 낮음 focuses on neutral and gentle smiles; 보통 adds sadness, a big laugh, playful cute expressions, and serious looks; 높음 also adds anger, surprise, a wink, worry, and determined expressions. Face-only and balanced face images use broader expression diversity, while balanced body images use strong expressions more sparingly. Views from above and below always use a natural neutral expression and an upright head so camera perspective remains the main learning target.
표정_변화.description: Controls expression range. 낮음 focuses on neutral and gentle smiles; 보통 adds sadness, a big laugh, playful cute expressions, and serious looks; 높음 also adds anger, surprise, a wink, worry, and determined expressions. 정체성_보존.name: Identity Preservation
정체성_보존.tooltip: Controls how strongly the Qwen edit prompt locks facial identity. Stronger settings improve recognizability but can reduce the strength of large viewpoint changes.
정체성_보존.description: Controls how strongly the Qwen edit prompt locks facial identity. Stronger settings improve recognizability but can reduce the strength of large viewpoint changes.

The selected model variant does not change this ratio policy.
